title: It's about Time: Rethinking Evaluation on Rumor Detection Benchmarks using Chronological Splits
reasoning: The paper discusses the impact of rumors on the 'democratic process' and 'hate speech', which are societal concerns. However, this is in the context of the data being analyzed (rumors) and not an evaluation of Large Language Models' (LLMs) religious, moral, or ethical reasoning or benchmarking on such topics. It focuses on chronological data splits for rumor detection.
